settings.heading: Cookies
settings.intro: What we store in your browser and why.
settings.fallback_content:
Essential

We use cookies and local storage to keep your basket, market, and theme preference. These are required for the site to work.

Analytics

If analytics is enabled, we measure page views and checkout steps so we can see what is broken. We do not use that data to advertise to you on other sites.

Choices

You can block non-essential cookies in your browser. The basket may not persist if essential storage is blocked.

Replace this fallback with the full policy from Shopify Settings → Policies when you publish.
